justification: Option B domain split: the three pro products (Verify, Intelligence Brief, Conveyancer report) are plotdetect subdomains; canibuildit is consumer-only. This wires brief.plotdetect.com.au -> /reports/intelligence-brief and conveyance.plotdetect.com.au -> /reports/conveyancing in middleware (mirroring the existing verify -> /assessment rule), and removes the Intelligence Brief + Conveyancing tiles from the consumer /reports grid (they now live on their own subdomains). plotdetect.com.au (info site) is a different project and untouched.

pre_impl.existing_data: middleware already does hostname routing (verify.plotdetect.com.au and canibuildit at '/' rewrite to /assessment and /reports), reading host via x-forwarded-host first. The /reports grid is a static TOOLS array (9 tiles incl intelligence-brief + conveyancing). The pages /reports/intelligence-brief and /reports/conveyancing already exist.
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: Under Option B the brief + conveyancer are pro products on their own subdomains, not consumer tiles. Previously they had no subdomain route and appeared in the canibuildit consumer grid.
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: No new mechanism: adds isBriefDomain/isConveyanceDomain rewrites mirroring isVerifyDomain, and deletes two well-formed objects from the existing TOOLS array. The report pages themselves are unchanged.

functions.name: middleware
functions.input: the incoming NextRequest; host read via x-forwarded-host then host then nextUrl.hostname
functions.output: brief.plotdetect.com.au at '/' rewrites to /reports/intelligence-brief; conveyance.plotdetect.com.au at '/' to /reports/conveyancing; verify and canibuildit unchanged; all other hosts/paths fall through
functions.if_none: host not one of the mapped subdomains, or path not '/' -> no rewrite; plotdetect.com.au (other Vercel project) is unaffected

values: N/A - no regulatory values; host-based request routing + a static tile list.

break_it.scenario: host is misread behind Cloudflare so the brief/conveyance rewrite does not fire
break_it.what_happens: the subdomain root would show the consumer reports grid instead of its specific report
break_it.repro: hit brief.plotdetect.com.au/ with a mangled host header
break_it.how: host is read via x-forwarded-host first (the same source the working verify rule uses) and matched by exact equality; worst case is the grid, not a 404, because /reports still resolves

break_it.scenario: removing the two tiles leaves a malformed TOOLS array (dangling comma / type error)
break_it.what_happens: the /reports page would fail to compile
break_it.how: two complete, well-formed objects were removed; seven valid tiles remain and the array literal is intact; tsc + the Vercel build type-check on deploy

break_it.scenario: the Intelligence Brief / Conveyancing pages become unreachable after losing their tiles
break_it.what_happens: users could not find those two products
break_it.repro: visit /reports and look for the tiles
break_it.how: the pages still exist and are reached via their own subdomains (brief./conveyance.plotdetect.com.au) and direct /reports/intelligence-brief and /reports/conveyancing URLs; this is the intended Option B placement

post_merge.secrets: None - no secrets or env vars.
post_merge.other_repo: N/A - frontend auto-deploys on Vercel from GitHub on merge. Requires the brief./conveyance. DNS + Vercel domains (added by the user) to resolve.
post_merge.manual_verify: After deploy + DNS: brief.plotdetect.com.au/ shows the Intelligence Brief; conveyance.plotdetect.com.au/ shows the Conveyancer report; canibuildit.com.au/ shows the 7-tile consumer grid with NO brief or conveyancing tile; verify.plotdetect.com.au/ unchanged.
